name: National Citizen Party
contribution: Launched in 2025 by leaders associated with the July 2024 uprising, the party introduced a youth-led reform platform into national electoral politics.
context: Post-uprising political transition, demands for institutional reform, and competition among established and emerging parties before national elections.
impact: Its rise expanded the electoral field with a new generation-led actor and pushed governance-reform and representation debates into mainstream campaigning.
seoTitle: National Citizen Party: Bangladesh’s Student-Led Political Force
seoDescription: Explore the National Citizen Party, its July 2024 movement links, youth-led reform platform, and place in Bangladesh’s post-uprising political transition.
shortAnswer: The National Citizen Party is a student-led Bangladeshi political party formed after the July 2024 uprising around a youth-led reform platform.
